effect:
Ups Sp.Atk gain, but lowers Speed.

Power Lens is the Special Attack version of the Power item set. When your Pokémon defeats an opponent while holding this item, all party members that gain EVs (including Exp. Share holders) receive an extra +8 Special Attack EVs.

Like all Power items, the Speed penalty is only active during battle while held. **Important:** The bonus only applies if the holder defeats the opponent—switching to a different Pokémon loses the bonus. Pair with Pokérus for even faster training!
